notes.title: Forever Epic Story [Music EP] Leaving Steam Store: Major Update
notes.content: [p][b]Forever Epic Story \[Music EP][/b] will be leaving Steam Store to prepare for the launch of the [b]Full Album version.[/b] We are releasing the album version in Early Access soon and will not be supporting the EP version any longer. If you purchased a copy of this app, you will still have access to use this ap and have access to claim your free access gift (read below). We are also submitting a final updated version before you remove this app.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531200/"][/dynamiclink]I would first like to thank everyone who has supported our app and would like to offer a free access key that would allow you to create 1 account to our [b]fan website[/b] that would provide free access to the album and updated app after the Online Launch. [/p][h1]Instructions on how to claim your FREE Gift: [/h1][olist][*][p] To claim your gift, you simply need to own a copy of [i][b]Forever Epic Story: A Journey of Life \[Music EP][/b][/i] in your game inventory (the mouse icon will appear next to your name). [/p][/*][*][p] Post in this thread [i][b]"gift me"[/b][/i] and we will send you an access key ([b]NOT[/b] a steam key) via private message. [/p][/*][*][p]To redeem your access, sign in and register here: [url="https://www.foreverepicstory.com/signin"]https://www.foreverepicstory.com/signin[/url][/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
We just included a major update:

[list]
[*] New look
[*] New EP including 4 mp3 song downloads
[*] 4 music videos 
[*] an updated map and interactive experience. 
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update to Application
notes.content: We've included the full video with lyrics for "Strider - No Hating On Me" and updated the application with new text and included bio link. We will be working on the fan site and updating content and features as well. More to come.
